close_reason: Implemented: tls_policy_effective startup log, tls_11_client_hello_is_rejected test (verifies rejection), server_config_cipher_suites_are_approved test. All verified passing.
description:
## Why
The epic requires a startup log line showing effective TLS policy and a test verifying TLS 1.1 is rejected.

## What
- Emit tracing::info! at server startup with min_tls_version and cipher_suite_count
- Add unit test in stoa-tls that builds a ServerConfig and asserts supported_protocol_versions() does not include TLS 1.0 or 1.1
- Add integration test that opens a TLS connection with max_protocol_version = TLS 1.1 and verifies handshake error

## Acceptance
- Startup log shows event=tls_policy_effective, min_tls_version, cipher_suite_count
- Test for TLS 1.1 rejection passes
title: TLS policy: startup log line and TLS 1.1 rejection test
